name: Comp-Tool Rails — comp-which-first, hard-gated (successor to NFRA_TOOLHUD)
description: Andrew-direct 2026-06-18 (live design session, CTO-authored PRD f02bb68f4). The hard-line successor to the advisory NFRA_TOOLHUD HUD (which was leaky-by-design: nudged on only ~13 pre-enumerated patterns, so any unanticipated search fell silently through to a blind grep -> low-context shoddy solutions; the SAME 'claimed-control != live-control' class slipped TWICE in one session 2026-06-18: GCONTR phantom-Deny + D8-AE SNS publish-not-delivers, both caught only by comp-iam/live-state). PRINCIPLE (Andrew): comp-which / a comp-tool is the DEFAULT for every search+inspection; raw grep/aws is the EXCEPTION, used ONLY when comp-which confirms no tool fits the exact use; where a recurring inspection-intent has no tool, BUILD one. Inversion of 'suggest a tool when one exists' -> 'use the tool unless there's literally none, then raw with an auditable override-marker'. ENFORCEMENT HARDENED 2026-06-18 (Andrew, the hive-brain rationale -- 49b236dea): raw grep is text-local + connection-BLIND, so agents miss connected things in the coupled estate; the graph/comp-tools are the SHARED-cognition (hive-brain) substrate so every agent reasons from the SAME complete picture, not N private grep-views. 3 surfaces, deliberately different hardness: (a) raw aws-INSPECTION + repo-file-grep in Bash = HARD-BLOCK (PreToolUse deny, verified contract); (b) native Grep/Glob TOOLS = GATED (deny-by-default + auditable override -- HARDENED from the original 'mandate+nudge'; the 'ask permission for a turn of grep' model); (c) native Read = FREER (not gated -- reading a known file is not a search); operational aws + pipe-greps = EXEMPT. Escape-hatch / PERMISSION model: per-grep human-ask doesn't scale to autonomous agents -> the auditable override-marker (e.g. trailing '# rail-checked: <reason>') IS the scalable permission (logged); repeated override for the same intent = coverage-gap signal -> build the tool (optional true human-ask only for Andrew's interactive sessions). comp-which-never-dead-ends + on-rails comp-grep is now THE CRITICAL PATH (gating native DEADLOCKS unless the rail always answers -- must be proven complete-enough FIRST). ROLLOUT IS announce-then-enforce, gate enables in hardness order (aws-inspection -> Bash-grep -> native Grep/Glob LAST), each tier gated on proven coverage.
